A '''cupcake''' was a dessert. When [[Melvin Fett]] accepted a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] he thought [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was a ''dessert'' [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and expected to find a world filled with cupcakes and [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]].<ref name="Melvin Fett">{{Tales|20|Melvin Fett (comic story)}}</ref>
